neighbours.label: A noun used as a modifier right before the noun it modifies, in set compounds (killer whale, prostate cancer, desalination research, photography business)
fire: Biologists suspect that more than one killer whale type may actually be a separate species.
The samples came from patients with lethal metastatic prostate cancers collected during surgery.
The committee published a research agenda on desalination plants for dry coastal regions.
Many talented people fail in the photography business even when their pictures are excellent.
The hospital runs a diabetes clinic every Tuesday for newly diagnosed patients.
He works for a small software company that sells tax tools to farmers.
The lecture covered coffee prices and the shipping industry in the nineteenth century.
She opened a bicycle repair shop on the corner of the old market square.
quiet: Biologists suspect that more than one large and aggressive whale type may actually be a separate species.
The samples came from patients who were seriously ill, collected during surgery at the hospital.
The committee published a long agenda for the dry coastal regions after its spring meeting.
Many talented people fail when they start out, even when their pictures are excellent and bold.
The hospital runs a free clinic every Tuesday for people who have just been diagnosed.
He works for a small company that is owned by two brothers and sells tools to farmers.
The lecture covered the rising prices and the long history of the nineteenth century.
She opened a repair shop on the corner of the old market square, near the station.
